title: Rebuilt checkout as a 0->1 service
raw_evidence: Took the failing legacy checkout from concept to launch as a new service. Owned the vision and MVP scope in an ambiguous space where two teams disagreed on approach; built the business case, ran the rollout, and handled the incident when payments regressed in week one. (Fictional example for schema illustration.)
guardrails: Say 'incremental ARR', not the internal revenue figure.
Led product; did not write the payment integration.

framings.text: Rebuilt checkout 0->1 and lifted conversion +18% (A/B, 6 weeks), ~$4M first-year incremental ARR.
Took a failing checkout to a new service 0->1 — owned scope in an ambiguous two-team space and drove the rollout, including week-one incident response.
